title: Third parties: vendors outside the town

calledBy.description: Our systems that call this vendor. Its health is read from the errors and latency of those calls. Required unless the vendor has services.

slaP99Ms.description: How slow the vendor may get before it counts as degraded.

domains.description: Host names (and everything under them) that belong to this vendor, so link discovery recognises a call to one as a vendor call instead of reporting it as unresolved.

internal.description: The company's own services outside the monitored platform, not a third party. Shown with an internal label.

services.description: The vendor stands on one island with a building for each service. A call is sent to the service whose match fits its address.

id.description: Short id; the building is the vendor id, a dash and this.

match.description: Which calls go to this service. A call matching any entry is a call to it; the first service that matches wins.

host.description: A host name; the host itself and everything under it match.

path.description: A regular expression the call's path must match. Without it every path on the host matches.

calledBy.description: Our systems that call this service, besides the ones link discovery finds.
